consequence.statement: A new optional way to set keystore passwords is added; existing passwordSecretRef usage is not stated to change.

assertion.statement: cert-manager v1.17 adds a literal `password` field for PKCS#12 and JKS keystores on Certificate, mutually exclusive with `passwordSecretRef`.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: text names a new `password` field for both PKCS#12 and JKS keystores without giving the exact schema path(s); applicability: purely additive optional feature; no environment state is described in which a consequence occurs
